Your two requests for hardship help: Our records show you called us on June 18 and June 30 about hardship options. Your June 18 request was logged as pending review. We found no return call and no decision on your request after that date through July 10.

Fees adding up each week: Our records show six $15 weekly extension fees on your loan, charged on June 5, June 12, June 19, June 26, July 3 and July 10, totaling $90. These fees are on your account as recorded, and no change to them has been approved. A fee deferral is one of the options listed above and can be considered as part of the hardship review. It is not approved unless and until a supervisor's sign-off is recorded.

Next steps: Please reply to this message or call the number on your account so we can go over which option fits your situation. It will help if you can briefly describe the nature of your hardship. You do not need to provide documentation at this stage.
